sampling_law.description: uniform over the published input box (the Level 0 study sheet's population, as EV5's), drawn by carbon.battery.seeds.make_batch

subgroups: the published important region reported separately

custody.made_on: the validator host only: seeds.make_batch from the testnet deployment's committed root (the root holding EV5 and graphite-confirmation-v1, so both are checked by regeneration), committed to its seed journal under the writer lock before any use; never in the repository, never in a pool
custody.solved_on: the operator host's CPU only (carbon.challenge_validator.tuning): never in a pod plan, rented compute, the attack knowledge store or a Graphite session; scored operator-side only, repeatedly, for score development

decisions: OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-08 §1: battery's tuning set, role graphite-tuning-v1, 200 cases plus 4 hidden duplicates, the Level 0 study sheet's population, sealed and solved on the operator host's CPU; no overlap with EV5, graphite-confirmation-v1, the rotating pool, TRAIN, PRACTICE or the practice decision set
OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-05 §4: the Level 0 population is one uniform law with no strata (NONE_UNIFORM_LAW)
TRAIN and PRACTICE are checked as published cases (daemon.published_inputs); the rotating pool and the practice decision set as operator-supplied private priors
